QuestInfo.name: A Pale Threat
QuestInfo.0: It seems that's all, but ask one more time to make sure.
QuestInfo.1: You saved the citizens, but there are still monsters at large. Go and defeat them before they attack more citizens!
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the monsters, but fell before the man with strange powers. Who is he? And what will happen to you?

0.msg: Are there more people hiding here?

2.msg: In the front? Are there more monsters there, too?

3.msg: Y-yeah...they're bigger and s-scarier, too. Let's run, it's not worth it!

no.0: It was so scary! I don't want this!
